flight_path: LAUNCH -> PRE-FLIGHT DEEP SYNC -> EXECUTE -> IN-FLIGHT CHECKPOINT/ROUTE-AS-NEEDED -> POST-FLIGHT DEEP SYNC -> ROOT LANDING RECEIPT -> READBACK
purpose: Owner-directed Category A governance implementation: enforce dynamic flight path, crash/context recovery, pre/post deep-sync and Root receipt discipline.
launch_basis: Owner directive in the current conversation; preflight sweep completed against accessible Blue State, mandate registry, canonical ROOT/INTAKE, recent deep-sync receipts, Notion governance, files/library, automation and connected repository/service surfaces.

preflight_snapshot.coverage_boundary: Accessible connector surfaces checked; complete transcript/session and all-platform enumeration not established. Continue reconciliation and explicitly carry inaccessible or unverified surfaces as OPEN.

preservation.prior_weights: Preserve existing weights exactly; update only through the existing governed outcome->attribution->weight->selection process.
preservation.learnings: Keep prior verified and disputed learnings with provenance and supersession state; do not overwrite historical truth.
preservation.anchors: Preserve current source refs, hashes, next actions, owners, blockers, no-contact/safety constraints and irreversible-action dedupe state.
preservation.recovery_rule: If this flight ends before a LANDING event, the next wake must resume this flight ID from the latest durable checkpoint.
